questions.question: Which folder holds Model files in a CodeIgniter project?
choices: application/views
application/models
application/config
application/helpers

questions.question: A Model class must extend which built-in class?
choices: CI_View
CI_Loader
CI_Model
CI_Controller

questions.question: What is the main job of a Model?
choices: To show the finished page layout to the site visitor
To handle the data, like reading rows from a table
To catch the URL request and send it to the right method
To store the HTML that the browser will end up displaying
questions.answer: To handle the data, like reading rows from a table

questions.question: Why do we put database code in the Model instead of the Controller?
choices: Because the Controller is not allowed to hold any code at all
Because the Model runs faster than the Controller on every request
Because the database only accepts calls that come from a Model file
Because it keeps the Controller short and lets others reuse the code
questions.answer: Because it keeps the Controller short and lets others reuse the code

questions.question: Two different pages both need the same list of students. What is the better way?
choices: Let both pages call the same method in one Model
Copy the same query into each of the two Controllers
Write the query inside each View so the pages stay apart
Make one Model file for every page that needs the list
questions.answer: Let both pages call the same method in one Model

questions.question: What happens when a Controller uses a Model but forgets to load it first?
choices: CodeIgniter loads the Model on its own without any warning
The page still works but the returned data comes back empty
The Model file is created automatically inside the folder
An error appears saying the property could not be found
questions.answer: An error appears saying the property could not be found

questions.question: Which config file holds your database connection details?
choices: routes.php
config.php
database.php
constants.php

questions.question: Which setting tells CodeIgniter the name of the database to use?
choices: password
database
hostname
username

questions.question: A page shows a database connection error. What is the most likely cause?
choices: The Model file was saved using the wrong class name
The table has no rows in it yet so nothing was found
The View was not loaded after the Controller method ran
The details in database.php do not match the real setup
questions.answer: The details in database.php do not match the real setup

questions.question: Which tag wraps the fields so that they are all sent together on submit?
choices: <form>, which groups the fields into one submission
<input>, which marks the start of the field group
<label>, which names the group of fields for the user
<div>, which holds the group of fields on the page
questions.answer: <form>, which groups the fields into one submission

questions.question: Which two attributes does a <form> need before its data can reach the right place?
choices: id and class, which name the form for styling
name and value, which label the data being sent
action and method, which set where and how it is sent
type and required, which set the kind of field used
questions.answer: action and method, which set where and how it is sent

questions.question: A page holds two separate forms. You fill in both, then submit only the first one. What gets sent?
choices: All the fields on the page, since they share one page
Only the fields inside the form that you submitted
Only the very first field of each form on the page
Nothing, because two forms on one page cancel out
questions.answer: Only the fields inside the form that you submitted

questions.question: What does the action attribute tell the browser?
choices: The name to save the collected data under
The message to show once the data is sent
The button that will act as the submit button
The address to send the data to on submit
questions.answer: The address to send the data to on submit
